title: Komentar staf UNESCO Jakarta soal kontrak

images.alt: Komentar LinkedIn Undral Ganbaatar pukul 5:06 pm: ia menyatakan Abil tidak memiliki kontrak kerja atau konsultansi dengan UNESCO Jakarta dan meminta konfirmasi peran di KORIKA kepada KORIKA

shows: Komentar akun bernama Undral Ganbaatar (pukul 5:06 pm): “I can tell you he did not have a contract of employment or consultancy with UNESCO Jakarta. You will have to confirm with KORIKA regarding his duties there. I cannot comment on his involvement there.”
limits: Gambar memotong komentar sebelumnya sehingga siapa “he” yang dimaksud hanya terbaca dari konteks utas. Pernyataan ini tentang ada tidaknya kontrak kerja atau konsultansi, bukan tentang ada tidaknya pekerjaan lain dengan UNESCO; penulis sendiri menyatakan tidak dapat berkomentar soal peran di KORIKA. Jabatan penulis tidak terlihat pada gambar, dan tanggal tidak terlihat.

en.title: UNESCO Jakarta staff comment on a contract
alts: LinkedIn comment by Undral Ganbaatar at 5:06 pm: he states Abil had no employment or consultancy contract with UNESCO Jakarta and asks that his role at KORIKA be confirmed with KORIKA
en.shows: A comment by an account named Undral Ganbaatar (5:06 pm): "I can tell you he did not have a contract of employment or consultancy with UNESCO Jakarta. You will have to confirm with KORIKA regarding his duties there. I cannot comment on his involvement there."
en.limits: The image cuts off the earlier comment, so who "he" refers to can only be read from the context of the thread. The statement concerns whether an employment or consultancy contract existed, not whether any other work with UNESCO existed; the commenter himself says he cannot comment on the role at KORIKA. The commenter's position is not visible in the image, and the date is not visible.
